name: GPU-Accelerated D2VR
definition: A GPU-accelerated implementation of D2VR that incorporates facilities for occlusion culling and empty space skipping to achieve interactive or near-interactive rendering speeds.
summary: GPU-Accelerated D2VR is a GPU-accelerated implementation of Direct 2D Volume Rendering that achieves interactive speeds using occlusion culling and empty space skipping to support arbitrary volume orientations.
